from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,argparse
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('name');p.add_argument('--cpu',type=int,default=0);p.add_argument('--rounds',type=int,default=7);a=p.parse_args();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;history=[];cfg=out/(a.name+'-config.json')
def run(stage,series,tag):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'focused.py'),stage,'--series',str(series),'--config',cfg.name,'--cpu',str(a.cpu),'--rounds',str(a.rounds),'--tag',tag]
 with (out/f'{tag}-{stage}-{series}.log').open('wb') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 r=json.loads((out/f'{tag}-{stage}-{series}.json').read_text());print(tag,stage,series,r['change_percent'],flush=True);return r
for attempt in range(3):
 tag=f'{a.name}-pass{attempt}';rows=[run('aa',i,tag) for i in [1,2]];delta=max(r['aa_delta_percent'] for r in rows);history.append({'attempt':attempt,'tag':tag,'delta_percent':delta});(out/(a.name+'-aa-history.json')).write_text(json.dumps(history,indent=2)+'\n')
 if delta<=2:break
 if attempt==2:raise RuntimeError('AA unstable; no comparison decision')
 c=json.loads(cfg.read_text());c['iterations']*=2;cfg.write_text(json.dumps(c,indent=2)+'\n')
rows=[run('compare',i,tag) for i in [1,2]];changes=[r['change_percent'] for r in rows];limit=10 if a.name=='nobt' else 5
result={'tag':tag,'cpu':a.cpu,'delta_percent':delta,'iterations':rows[0]['case']['iterations'],'changes_percent':changes,'upper_limit_percent':limit,'both_within_limit':all(v<=limit for v in changes),'both_exceed_limit':all(v>limit for v in changes)}
(out/(a.name+'-decision.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(result,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;history=[]
def run(stage,series,tag,rounds):
 cmd=[sys.executable,str(out/'focused.py'),stage,'--series',str(series),'--rounds',str(rounds),'--tag',tag]
 with (out/f'{tag}-{stage}-{series}.log').open('wb') as log:subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 r=json.loads((out/f'{tag}-{stage}-{series}.json').read_text());print(tag,stage,series,r['change_percent'],flush=True);return r
for attempt in range(3):
 tag=f'loop-pass{attempt}';rows=[run('aa',i,tag,7) for i in [1,2]];delta=max(r['aa_delta_percent'] for r in rows);history.append({'attempt':attempt,'tag':tag,'delta_percent':delta});(out/'loop-aa-history.json').write_text(json.dumps(history,indent=2)+'\n')
 if delta<=2:break
 if attempt==2:raise RuntimeError('AA unstable; no comparison decision')
 p=out/'loop-config.json';c=json.loads(p.read_text());c['iterations']*=2;p.write_text(json.dumps(c,indent=2)+'\n')
rows=[run('compare',i,tag,7) for i in [1,2]];result={'tag':tag,'delta_percent':delta,'iterations':rows[0]['case']['iterations'],'changes_percent':[r['change_percent'] for r in rows],'passes_loop_condition':all(-r['change_percent']>=10 and -r['change_percent']>2*delta for r in rows)}
(out/'loop-decision.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(result,flush=True)
